content:
I can read and work with text in a lot of languages, but I don’t have a fixed exact number.

Broadly:
- I’m strongest in widely used languages like English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, and many more.
- I can also often handle less widely used languages to varying degrees.
- My ability is not equal across all languages: some I understand very well, some only partially, and some only in short/simple text.

If you want, you can test me with a sentence in any language.
